name: Lendio
description: Lendio is a small business lending marketplace that connects businesses with funding through a network of 75+ lenders. The platform offers a REST API for submitting loan applications, checking eligibility, connecting businesses with lenders, and managing loan products.

offers.name: Lendio Loan Marketplace API
offers.description: REST API for connecting small businesses with lenders. Supports loan application submission, eligibility checking, lender matching, and loan product management. The Embedded Financing API allows service providers to integrate the Lendio marketplace with a single JavaScript snippet and authentication API endpoint for secure customer data sharing.

offers.name: Lendio Loan Performance Tracking API
offers.description: API integration for high-volume lenders that allows bulk submission of loan performance data. Supports up to 10,000 records per submission through custom code requests.
